Top-level: mid-market SaaS firm building a customer-facing conversational assistant and document summarization flow. Started with hosted API eval (Jan–Feb). Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate latency/throughput and isolation requirements.

POC scope (explicit):
- Environment: Dedicated pool (eu-west and us-west), VPC peering with CopperWillow staging VPC.
- Duration: 2 weeks canary + 4 weeks extended evaluation if canary metrics hit targets.
- Canary traffic: start at 10% production-like traffic, ramp to 50% over 72h if p95 latency < 120ms and error rate < 0.5%.
- Throughput target: sustained 50 req/s per region (burst 200 req/s).
- Models: primary = open LLMQuant-3B-compat (quantized), fallback = LLMQuant-1.4B variant (lower cost), regional variant: eu-west primary, us-west mirror.
- Routing: canary route via blue/green deploy for model variant. Smart routing policy: prefer eu-west for EU users, fallback to us-west when capacity constrained or when health-check failure.
- Fallback policy: automatic failover to smaller model variant in same region; if region health bad, failover to other region with model variant mapping preserved.
- Rollback criteria: automatic rollback on quality regression (BLEURT drop > 4 points on canary eval suite) or latency breach p95 > 200ms for > 10 minutes. Manual rollback if unexplained increased hallucination reports (>3 high-severity incidents in 24h).
- Observability: token-level cost + latency dashboards in Console; trace hooks enabled for 5% of calls for debugging.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must integrate with CopperWillow's Okta SSO (SAML).
- KMS integration required for key wrapping of model artifacts and audit_log retention 1y.
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in eu-west for primary processing and KV caches.

Cost sensitivity:
